items.prompt: A strikingly bare apartment in an old Moscow building: a table, two chairs, shelves of books, a low sofa, nothing else; no mug, no cables, no clutter. On one shelf, among the books, sits a smooth black egg-shaped object the size of a melon, catching a single highlight.

alt.ru: Подчёркнуто пустая квартира в старом московском доме: стол, два стула, полки с книгами, низкий диван; на одной полке среди книг гладкое чёрное яйцо размером с дыню.
alt.en: A strikingly bare flat in an old Moscow building: a table, two chairs, bookshelves, a low sofa; on one shelf among the books a smooth black egg the size of a melon.
alt.pt: Um apartamento invulgarmente despido num prédio antigo de Moscovo: mesa, duas cadeiras, estantes, um sofá baixo; numa prateleira entre os livros, um ovo preto liso do tamanho de um melão.
alt.es: Un piso llamativamente vacío en un edificio antiguo de Moscú: mesa, dos sillas, estanterías, un sofá bajo; en un estante entre los libros, un huevo negro liso del tamaño de un melón.

items.prompt: Close view of a bare wooden table between two men whose hands rest on its edges: in the centre stands a smooth black egg-shaped object, its surface so dark it seems to swallow light, a faint reflection of the room curving across it.

alt.ru: Голый деревянный стол между двумя мужчинами, их руки на краях; в центре гладкое чёрное яйцо, поверхность которого будто поглощает свет.
alt.en: A bare wooden table between two men, hands on its edges; in the centre a smooth black egg whose surface seems to swallow light.
alt.pt: Uma mesa de madeira entre dois homens, mãos nas bordas; ao centro um ovo preto liso cuja superfície parece engolir a luz.
alt.es: Una mesa de madera entre dos hombres, manos en los bordes; en el centro un huevo negro liso cuya superficie parece tragarse la luz.
